title: UV-blocking and mechanically reinforced starch films incorporating Ce-UiO-66 nanoparticles for food packaging applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,30415-30426
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03117F, Paper

Giang H. Le, Duong A. Thanh, Trang T. T. Pham, Quang Vinh Tran, Nhiem Ngoc Dao, Kien Trung Nguyen, Són Tung Pham, Trang T. T. Quan
At just 1 wt% Ce-UiO-66, films deliver broad-spectrum UV shielding (UVA 83.5%, UVB 95.6%, UVC 100%) and improved barrier/mechanics. Dual functionality: visible-light photocatalysis degrades 65% RR195, enabling multifunctional food-packaging and remediation.
